sections.heading: KVG College of Engineering vs NIT Surathkal for MBA / PGDM: which is better in 2026
paragraphs: Choose KVG College of Engineering if you want a recorded fee of ₹40,000, and an admission route through CAT, in a private MBA / PGDM setting at Mangalore.
Choose NIT Surathkal if you want a recorded fee of ₹70,000, and an admission route through CAT, in a public MBA / PGDM setting at Mangalore.

sections.heading: Fees: what our records show, and what the official pages say
paragraphs: On this page we quote a programme total when we hold a Total Fees record, and we skip short, executive or certificate rows when the picker can tell them apart. Always match the fee to the exact programme you will join.

Our records show ₹40,000 as a tuition figure for MBA Finance at KVG College of Engineering. Treat this as a recorded tuition figure, not a confirmed two-year total, unless the official notice says otherwise.

Our records show ₹70,000 as a tuition figure for MBA Financial Management at NIT Surathkal. Treat this as a recorded tuition figure, not a confirmed two-year total, unless the official notice says otherwise.

sections.heading: Placements compared
paragraphs: We do not hold a 2020-or-later flagship placement year for KVG College of Engineering here, so do not treat older or unofficial packages as current.
We do not hold a 2020-or-later flagship placement year for NIT Surathkal here, so do not treat older or unofficial packages as current.
If you are comparing offers, use the latest official placement report from each institute and match the programme name, not an executive or certificate batch.

sections.heading: Admission and eligibility
paragraphs: KVG College of Engineering is listed on our records with CAT as an admission route for this MBA / PGDM comparison. Confirm the current brochure for cut-offs, interviews and any extra institute test.
NIT Surathkal is listed on our records with CAT as an admission route for this MBA / PGDM comparison. Confirm the current brochure for cut-offs, interviews and any extra institute test.
Eligibility wording can change by cycle. Use the current official admission brochure rather than last year's cut-off stories.

sections.heading: Location and campus
paragraphs: Both campuses are in {{cityA}}, Karnataka. If you want to stay in this city, the choice is less about relocation and more about the classroom, fees and the admission route.
KVG College of Engineering is listed as a private institute and NIT Surathkal as a public institute on our records. That difference can affect fees, seat reservations and campus culture.

sections.heading: Verdict: who should pick which college

faqs.question: Which is better in 2026, KVG College of Engineering or NIT Surathkal?
faqs.answer: It depends on the programme you want. KVG College of Engineering and NIT Surathkal differ in more than one way: one is listed as private and the other as public. Check official fees, the admission test and the latest placement report before you choose.

faqs.question: What are the recorded fees for KVG College of Engineering vs NIT Surathkal?
faqs.answer: our records list ₹40,000 for KVG College of Engineering on MBA Finance; our records list ₹70,000 for NIT Surathkal on MBA Financial Management. Confirm both official notices before you decide.

faqs.question: How do placements compare for KVG College of Engineering and NIT Surathkal?
faqs.answer: We do not hold a 2020-or-later flagship placement year for KVG College of Engineering here, so do not treat older or unofficial packages as current.

faqs.question: Which entrance exams do KVG College of Engineering and NIT Surathkal accept?
faqs.answer: Our records list CAT for KVG College of Engineering, and CAT for NIT Surathkal. Always confirm the current admission brochure, because tests and cut-offs change by year.

faqs.question: Are KVG College of Engineering and NIT Surathkal in the same city?
faqs.answer: Yes. Both are in Mangalore, Karnataka. The move is about the programme, fees and tests, not a change of city.

faqs.question: Should I treat this comparison as a final admission decision?
faqs.answer: No. Fees, eligibility and placements change by year and by programme. Verify the current official fee notice, admission brochure and placement report of each institute before you apply.
